title: O! Kali mou xanthia - Manos Hadjidakis (performed by Yiorgos Fanourakis)
description:
Municipality of Crete Youth Symphony Orchestra
Youth Choir of the Municipality of Heraklion
"Nikos Kazantzakis" Garden Theater
3 July 2018

'Oh, my dear blonde.'
Aristophanes, Birds
composer: Manos Hadjidakis
poetry: Vasilis Rotas

Conductor: Miltos Logiadis
Artistic direction: Ioannis Idomeneos
Performance: Yiorgos Fanourakis

Lyrics
Oh! my dear blonde,
my sweet companion,
that I talk with you
every nice cause,
came, came, Fanis
with suraurus to weave
hymns, singing,
spring sounds.

Go ahead, start, tell them
sweets for the restless.
